mapper.select: SELECT wb.id, wb.code, wb.name, wb.description, wb.total_words, wb.created_at FROM word_books wb ORDER BY wb.id
SELECT wb.id, wb.code, wb.name, wb.description, wb.total_words, wb.created_at FROM word_books wb WHERE wb.id = #{bookId}
SELECT wb.id, wb.code, wb.name, wb.description, wb.total_words, wb.created_at FROM word_books wb WHERE LOWER(wb.code) = LOWER(#{code}) LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO word_books (code, name, description, total_words) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{description}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE word_books SET code = #{code}, name = #{name}, description = #{description}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM words WHERE book_id = #{bookId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM review_logs WHERE word_id IN (SELECT id FROM words WHERE book_id = #{bookId})
DELETE FROM user_word_progress WHERE word_id IN (SELECT id FROM words WHERE book_id = #{bookId})
